marriott-2023.every_line: Read line by line against the filing. Two bold stand-alone lines are the item's top-level categories (Risks Relating to Our Industry, Risks Relating to Our Business); four underlined stand-alone lines are the categories inside the second (Operational Risks; Development and Financing Risks; Technology, Information Protection, and Privacy Risks; Governance Risk); every other line is the bold sentence that opens one risk factor and leads into its body. Each is a heading of Item 1A under the approved definition's heading-level list, and no heading-marked line in the item is missing.
